calculation.reason: The official annual judicial-rate history is modeled, but claim-specific accrual, contract and government branches, day count, payment allocation, and every special statute are not deterministic.

annual_rate.notes: Louisiana OFI publishes a 7.5% judicial rate for calendar year 2026 under R.S. 13:4202(B). The schedule changes by calendar year rather than locking at judgment. Contracts, tort accrual, government defendants, and other statutes can alter the applicable path. Civil Code art. 2001 permits interest on accrued interest only through a new agreement after accrual, so automatic compounding is not assumed. The official dated history begins September 12, 1980. Not legal advice.
